name: @plantuml-mcp/plantuml-mcp

tools.name: plantuml-generate
tools.description:
Generate PlantUML diagrams from code. Returns Base64 encoded image data, or saves to file if save_path/savePath is provided (Base64 data omitted when saving to reduce bandwidth).

Parameters:
- code (required): PlantUML source code including @startuml/@enduml tags
- format (optional): Output format - png|svg|pdf|eps (default: png)
- save_path or savePath (optional): Local file path to save diagram (supports both naming conventions)

Example: {"code": "@startuml\nAlice -> Bob: Hello\n@enduml", "format": "png", "savePath": "./diagram.png"}

code.description: PlantUML source code (required). Must include @startuml and @enduml tags. Example: '@startuml\nAlice -> Bob: Hello\n@enduml'

format.description: Output image format (optional). Defaults to 'png'. Options: png (web), svg (scalable), pdf (documents), eps (publications)

save_path.description: Local file save path (optional). When provided, saves diagram to file and omits Base64 data from response to save bandwidth. Example: './diagrams/my-diagram.png'

savePath.description: Alias for save_path. Local file save path (optional). Supports both camelCase and snake_case naming conventions.

tools.name: plantuml-formats
tools.description:
Get list of supported diagram output formats from the PlantUML server.

Parameters: None required

Returns: Array of supported formats with recommendations for each format.

tools.name: plantuml-health
tools.description:
Check PlantUML server health and connectivity status.

Parameters: None required

Returns: Server status, health information, and connection details. Call this first to verify server accessibility.
